title: Measuring the Allowance to Return on a Removed Design Studio Selections Line
content:
**Posting rule.** On a Design Studio Selections file, the return measure for package allowance on a removed option line is set by how the removed line was credited:

1. where its removal credit was below the price at which it had been selected, the return measure is the allowance applied to it times its removal credit divided by that price, rounded half up to the cent;
2. where it was credited at its full price and allowance was applied to it in more than one entry, the return measure is the most recent allowance entry applied to it;
3. otherwise the return measure is all package allowance applied to it.

**Records read.** The line's selection entry (its selected price), its removal entry (its removal credit) and the package allowance credit applications carrying its line number, with their dates.

**Cases on hypothetical figures**

| Selected price | Removal credit | Package allowance applied | Return measure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3000.00 | 1500.00 | 1200.00 in one entry | 1200.00 times 1500.00 divided by 3000.00: 600.00 |
| 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 700.00, then 500.00 (two entries) | Most recent entry: 500.00 |
| 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 1200.00 in one entry | 1200.00 |
